commons.title: Ice fishing by Chief Isaacs, ca. 1900 - DPLA - 68ea3482d18f31ab2fd048927fc25d3d.jpg
commons.description: Transcribed from photograph: "Fishing. Ice fishing by Chief Isaacs. ca. 1905." Chief Isaacs was head of the Klondike band of the Han Indians. According to a description of the same photo in the University of Washington's digital collections, "Chief Isaacs of the Moosehide tribe. Angling through a hole in the ice. Moosehide Creek and village were a short distance downstream from Dawson."
commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies Chief Isaacs as head of the Klondike Han band, and the image shows him ice fishing, a culturally attributed activity.
